rv.q: A production filled with music, emotion, and talent that no theater lover—or Dolly fan—should miss.
DOLLY: A True Original Musical is as endearing and inspiring as the global superstar herself.
She rises to the well-nigh impossible challenge of actually becoming Dolly for a couple of hours on stage.
Dolly: A True Original Musical is worth every penny.
Clarke’s veteran presence was felt throughout the whole show.

cn.t: Critics warmly embrace this honest, relationship-focused musical, with Katie Rose Clarke earning praise for humanizing Dolly rather than just impersonating her, though the show emphasizes those who shaped her life over Parton herself.
